lyrics.text: Five bucks a lawn on Maple Street
Grass stains on my sneakers and the dog at my feet
Mrs. Alder's roses and her sweet iced tea
Saving every dollar for a six string for me
It's a lemonade summer, sticky and slow
Cut grass and sunshine wherever I go
Daddy says it's fine, just a rough patch, you'll see
It's a lemonade summer, and it's good enough for me
Porch light's on and Mama's singing low
Dad's out late again, but I guess I'll never know
Fireflies are blinking out across the yard
Counting up my money, and it isn't all that hard
It's a lemonade summer, sticky and slow
Cut grass and sunshine wherever I go
Daddy says it's fine, just a rough patch, you'll see
It's a lemonade summer, and it's good enough for me
Rough patch, rough patch, that's all it is
Every rose has got a thorn, and that's the way it is
It's a lemonade summer, sticky and slow
Cut grass and sunshine wherever I go
Daddy says it's fine, just a rough patch, you'll see
It's a lemonade summer, and it's good enough for me
